name: barkdown-workspace
description: Barkdown desktop workspace: notes and agents, powered by Barkpark.

scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/check.cjs && node scripts/check-plan.mjs && node scripts/release-plan.test.mjs && node scripts/runtime-postgres-bundle.test.mjs && node scripts/runtime-release-windows.test.mjs && node scripts/runtime-wasm-assets.test.mjs && node scripts/runtime-notices-windows.test.mjs && node scripts/reader-notices.test.mjs && node scripts/liveview-notices.test.mjs && node scripts/client-notices.test.mjs && node scripts/frontend-notices.test.mjs && node scripts/pe-export-data.test.mjs && node scripts/winpthreads-publisher.test.mjs && node scripts/postgres-notices.test.mjs && npm run check:cycle && npm run check:visual
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run check && npm test
scripts.test:desktop: npm --prefix app run build && npm --prefix app test
scripts.visual:capture: npm --prefix app run build && node app/tests/visual-capture.mjs
scripts.check:visual: node scripts/visual.test.mjs && node scripts/visual-approval.test.mjs && node scripts/visual-retain.test.mjs && node scripts/visual.mjs check && node scripts/visual-retain.mjs --check
